headline: Binance Discloses $6.3 Billion Crypto Hack, the Largest on Record
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said $6.3 billion of digital assets have been impacted in what is considered the biggest crypto hack on record.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, meaning major security breaches can disrupt confidence and liquidity across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance confirmed that $6.3 billion in digital assets under its platform were impacted by a record hack.
